descriptions:
Broken tooth, abscess or acute pain? Our clinic sees you the same day, no appointment needed.
Direct billing to insurers. Fees shown before treatment. Call now.
pageTitle: Emergency Dentist Montreal | Example Dental Clinic
body:
Home | Services | Team | Book | Contact

Do you have a dental emergency in Montreal? Our clinic sees walk-in patients Monday to Saturday. Our dentists treat acute pain, broken teeth, abscesses and lost fillings the same day. Call us before 3 pm to be seen today. The clinic is near Berri-UQAM metro. We accept most insurance plans and bill directly. Fees are shown before treatment. Our team speaks French, English and Spanish. Home | Services | Team | Book | Contact
